text:
nina: Quick heads-up, A/B canary (v2.0 -> v2.1) is showing token-level latency deltas on /api/chat/stream in the model-compare dashboard.

kai: link? :eyes:

nina: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/def/ab-compare?panelId=45

perf-bot: canary-start v2.1 2026-11-05T14:03:00Z

olga: I can see a p95 token latency spike for v2.1 right at canary start. Early tokens (1-20) look particularly bad.

marc: do we have kernel_selection logs for the canary shards? could be picking different kernels per shard.

sasha: grabbed runtime debug from canary-07: ```[2026-11-05T14:03:05Z] model=v2.1 route=/api/chat/stream selected_kernel=scaled_attn_fp16 shard=2``` and then ```[2026-11-05T14:03:07Z] model=v2.1 route=/api/chat/stream selected_kernel=scaled_attn_unfused_fp16 shard=2```

kai: kernel flip + shard inconsistency will trigger warm starts and KV cache churn -> latency.

nina: KV miss metric confirms it: redwood_runtime_kv_cache_miss_total{model="v2.1"} spikes ~4x around 2026-11-05T14:03.

olga: batching looks noisy too. current dynamic batch config: max_wait_ms=5, max_batch_tokens=2048. With more short requests, windows collapse and we get many tiny batches.

marc: quick PromQL I ran: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))` -> /api/chat/stream p95: v2.1=270ms vs v2.0=95ms. Clear regression.

sasha: note v2.1 includes a unicode-normalize tokenizer patch that increases token counts for some punctuation/emojis, changing seq_len distribution.

kai: suggestion: we should emit `runtime_kernel_choice_total{model,route,kernel}` and `request_seq_len_histogram{model,route}` so dashboards can correlate kernel choices with seq_len shifts.

nina: also surface KV hit ratio: redwood_runtime_kv_cache_hit_ratio{model,route} with a short rolling window (2m). Add to model-compare.

perf-bot: action: pin-canary-weight v2.1 3% by @kai

kai: pinned canary-07 kernel_override=scaled_attn_fp16 to validate impact.

olga: on pinned node p95 dropped from ~260ms -> ~110ms within 40s, KV misses subsided.

marc: confirms theory: kernel-selection oscillation + batching variance -> cache churn -> early-token p95 regression.

sasha: follow-ups:
- kai: emit kernel_choice_total + seq_len histogram metrics (ETA: today)
- sasha: PR to prefer fused kernel when seq_len variance > threshold (ETA: tomorrow)
- olga: add two Grafana panels (seq_len distribution by model+route, kernel_choice rates) + alert rule for p95 delta > 60ms (ETA: EOD)
- nina: update rollout runbook to check kernel_choice + kv hit ratio before increasing canary weight

deploy-bot: ticket INF-4922 created by @sasha for kernel pref change

nina: tagging @devex for panel layout / UX suggestions on exposing batching knobs and kernel choice on the model compare dashboard.

nina: Keeping this thread as the perf-observability action log. Will post links to the new panels when ready. :white_check_mark:
